concept: A stark, minimalist composition of a small house silhouette cut in half vertically—the left side plunged into absolute darkness, the right side faintly illuminated by a single dim light source. A family's shadow is barely visible inside. Around the house, fragmented geometric shapes suggest rubble, fractures, and collapse. The overall mood is cold, desperate, and stark, rendered in high contrast with heavy use of shadow and the faintest glow. Style: digital illustration with bold, blocky forms and a sense of profound isolation.
explanation: Today's headlines are dominated by catastrophe, conflict, and the stripping away of safety—from Ukraine's power collapse leaving families in darkness and cold, to hospital strikes, building collapses, and a missing child buried alive. Even the rare positive (Colom's historic win, the teen's rescue) are overwhelmed by the weight of suffering. The image distills the day's emotional core: the fragility of home, light, and survival in a world spiraling into darkness and chaos.

headlines.title: Ukraine's power supply close to critical as Russian strikes bring darkness and cold
headlines.summary: For parents in parts of Ukraine, trying to lead a normal family life with just a few hours of power each day is taking its toll.

headlines.title: Democrat Scott Colom seals historic win in Mississippi Senate race
headlines.summary: Colom is the first black person from the southern state elected to the US Senate in over 140 years.

headlines.title: Israeli strike on hospital kills at least five Palestinians, Gaza civil defence agency says
headlines.summary: The strike hit the surgery department of the hospital in Khan Younis, injuring at least 20 people and causing extensive damage, a spokesperson says.

headlines.title: New York building collapse kills at least two, officials say
headlines.summary: A dangerous search for survivors continues after a three-storey building collapsed in Brooklyn on Wednesday afternoon.

headlines.title: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike
headlines.summary: Tens of thousands of people have been taking part in the strike, called by the country's main unions over housing and the high cost of living.

headlines.title: Australian teen missing in bush for six days rescued alive
headlines.summary: The 17-year-old's mum has joked that he is "grounded for life" and "never leaving the house again".

headlines.title: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
headlines.summary: Talks in Abu Dhabi centred around Europe's security framework, with US envoys due to meet Putin and Zelensky on Thursday.

headlines.title: Kidnapper, 74, escapes from house arrest in Argentina by abseiling from balcony
headlines.summary: Leonardo Bertulazzi, a former member of the Marxist guerrilla group the Red Brigades, was about to be extradited to his home country of Italy.

headlines.title: Indonesia's vice president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
headlines.summary: The news comes at a turbulent time for Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.

headlines.title: Famed ship SS United States sunk off coast of Florida
headlines.summary: Activists unsuccessfully fought for the historic liner to be preserved and turned into a museum, but it will now become the world's largest artificial ocean reef.

headlines.title: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
headlines.summary: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public.

headlines.title: Missing 11-month-old baby rescued after being buried alive in a crate in South Carolina
headlines.summary: Officials say the child was found close to his father's home on Tuesday, a day after he was taken, and is being cared for in hospital.
